title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned War-Room Planning Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: War-Room Planning Board
options.thesis: Licensing work as a war-room board: prices snap on as magnetic plates while requirements cluster beside them.
options.viewport: Top bar with Import/Export and theme; left requirement clusters; right a dominant €57.20 recommendation plate with As-Is delta; quote strip pinned below.
options.risk: Can tip playful if cards read as stickies instead of price plates.

raised.raise: Recommendation price owns specimen-scale hierarchy: hero €, per-user, and delta as three deliberate size steps.
Shell commits a full charcoal board field; colour does jobs (selection teal, delta amber), never grey-plus-one-accent.

options.label: Professional Rate Card
options.lineage: professional services rate cards and fee schedules
options.thesis: The quote is a rate card: money columns lead, everything else supports the fee.
options.viewport: Top utility bar; requirements as dense checklist columns; recommendation as a locked right money column with €57.20 and +€12.40 delta; quote table as the rate-card body.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on: familiar consulting paperwork.

options.label: Acetate Reference Manual
options.lineage: boxed-software reference manuals with coloured tab boards and punched acetate leaves
options.thesis: Feature groups as coloured tab sections; As-Is vs To-Be as layered acetate; prices in machine mono.
options.viewport: Stepped tab rail for Productivity/Endpoint/Security/Compliance; work area on acetate over section hue; recommendation €57.20 in mono with Compare as a second hinged leaf.
options.case: Beats the roll on audience ID (consultants live in manuals) and clarity (tabs map to feature groups; acetate is literal As-Is/To-Be).
options.risk: Costume risk if acetate becomes literal plastic UI instead of type/palette/density/signature only.

options.label: Orienteering Course Map
options.lineage: ISO orienteering maps with purple course overlay
options.thesis: Requirements as fixed terrain colours; the recommendation rides as a purple course over them.
options.viewport: Top bar; requirements tinted as terrain legend; recommendation as purple course controls ending at €57.20 control circle; quote as punched controls list.
options.case: Holds product clarity (course = recommendation path) but loses audience identification for licensing consultants.
options.risk: Reads outdoor-sport if purple course becomes decoration instead of the decision path.

options.label: Crouwel Construction Grid
options.thesis: Visible construction grid; the recommendation price builds cell by cell as the proof.
options.viewport: Top bar on grid; requirements snapped to cells; €57.20 as monumental grid-built numerals; quote table on the same armature.
options.case: Holds clarity through ruthless hierarchy; weaker audience identification than consulting paper culture.
options.risk: Can freeze into poster specimen if the grid outranks the task.

options.label: Emigre Bitmap Specimen
options.case: Loses both axes: pixel novelty fights consultant trust and price legibility.
options.kept: Specimen-scale hierarchy of one figure at many sizes.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.lineage: mid-century zoo and gardens guide maps
options.case: Loses both: playful lobe colours violate the prices-first, not-playful brief.
options.kept: Committed coloured shell field instead of grey-plus-accent default.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Polished SaaS licensing calculator: clean grid, glass panels, indigo/gold accents, recommendation card beside requirements.
canonCard.viewport: Sticky glass nav; requirements cards left; recommendation hero right with € price; quote table below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the current glassmorphism incumbent by design.
